description: This file defines the interface 'LoanAccrualActivityProcessingService' for processing loan accrual activities in the Fineract system. It declares methods related to making and recalculating accrual transactions, as well as handling specific loan states like closure and reopen.

classes.name: LoanAccrualActivityProcessingService
classes.description: Interface for processing loan accrual activities within the Fineract system. It includes methods for creating and recalculating accrual transactions, as well as handling specific loan states such as closure and reopen.

methods.name: makeAccrualActivityTransaction
methods.description: Creates an accrual activity transaction for a specific loan identified by loanId on the specified date.

methods.name: makeAccrualActivityTransaction
methods.description: Creates an accrual activity transaction for a provided Loan object on the specified date.

methods.name: recalculateAccrualActivityTransaction
methods.description: Recalculates the accrual activity transaction based on the provided Loan and transaction details.

methods.name: processAccrualActivityForLoanClosure
methods.description: Processes accrual activities needed when a loan is closed.

methods.name: processAccrualActivityForLoanReopen
methods.description: Processes accrual activities when a loan is reopened.
